# LaMelo Ball TRADED To Minnesota! Charlotte, What Are You Doing?!

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-06-25, 26:56. https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0

## Summary

Josh Lloyd reacts to Charlotte trading LaMelo Ball to Minnesota for Naz Reid, a 2033 unprotected first-round pick, three second-round picks and three pick swaps he calls meaningless. He thinks Ball will probably be a third-round fantasy pick again, with more minutes and more scoring and assists in Minnesota. He thinks the trade hurts Ayo Dosunmu's fantasy upside and gives Jaden McDaniels a small bump. Minnesota has big holes at power forward and center. In Charlotte, Naz Reid should start at center and could put up monster fantasy numbers. Brandon Miller and Kon Knueppel get usage bumps, while Coby White's usage drops. He calls Charlotte's return laughably bad and pushes back on the idea that Ball is not a winning player.

## Rules and methods

- [19:11](https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0?t=1151) When a high-usage star leaves, his usage gets spread among the players who remain. Expect bumps for the secondary options and a dip for a bench scorer who moves into a lower priority role.
  > "So, you're losing Ball Diabate and you're replacing it with Reid and White. So, Miller and Knipel will get bumps."
- [7:59](https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0?t=479) A third offensive option needs big minutes and very efficient shooting to matter in fantasy. That is not a likely high-upside outcome.
  > "that guy that's going to need 33 minutes and need to have a true shooting of 61% to be relevant for fantasy"
- [17:52](https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0?t=1072) Don't be fooled by a player's per-game rank in nine-category leagues being inflated beyond his real value.
  > "He'll also probably be someone who gets night cat fluff to be looking like a top 30 player. Don't fall for that."
- [7:17](https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0?t=437) A team that needs to win will play its star more minutes than a cautious, rebuilding team did.
  > "Minnesota is like we we've got to win, man. Like he's going to play big minutes."
- [10:12](https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0?t=612) Games a player missed during a tank may not reflect real injury problems.
  > "Half of the games that LaMelo Ball missed in the last two seasons prior to this last one was not because he was injured, it was because they were tanking."
- [8:24](https://youtu.be/ya2VYRJ1BN0?t=504) Some players' usage spikes when a teammate is out. Losing a frontcourt usage player who shared lineups with them helps them.
  > "McDaniels is one of those players who's usage spikes when somebody is out."
